snippet.title: Style Me Girl - Trailer
snippet.description:
Ready to start your career as a fashion stylist? Wave your chic flag in Style Me Girl, the first 3D mobile fashion game! 

Show off your style! With hundreds of 3D fashion items to choose from, the chic possibilities are endless! Dress up friends, models, and even big stars on fabulous style challenges!
